visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor living room, a group of men is seen celebrating intensely. A man in a beige hoodie is being embraced and cheered by others, including a man in a gray long-sleeved shirt and a man in a black t-shirt. The background features a stone-textured fireplace and a dining area. (2) A man in a gray shirt and glasses sits at a 'Street Fighter II' arcade cabinet, focusing on the screen while manipulating the joystick and buttons. A man in a black t-shirt with a gold chain stands behind him, watching. (3) The arcade screen displays 'WIN' in large red letters. The man in gray stands up, holding a light-colored kitchen spatula, and walks toward the open-concept kitchen with a proud, slightly comical expression. (4) The man in gray returns to the machine for 'Round 2'. He plays with intensity, but the screen eventually shows his character's defeat. He leans his head against the machine in disappointment while his friends watch. (5) The man in the beige hoodie takes a turn at the arcade machine. He is hunched over, pressing buttons rapidly. His friends surround him, offering encouragement and watching the screen closely. (6) The man in the beige hoodie loses a match and collapses onto the carpeted floor in front of the fireplace, clutching his head. He eventually sits up, laughing at his own frustration. (7) After multiple attempts, the man in the beige hoodie finally wins. The entire group erupts into a massive celebration, jumping, shouting, and high-fiving. The camera captures their raw excitement in the domestic setting. (8) The group huddles around the machine as the man in beige starts the final stage. The atmosphere is tense but supportive, with friends placing hands on his shoulders. (9) Upon clearing the entire game, the screen shows the ending cinematic. The man in the beige hoodie stands up and shouts directly at the camera, raising his arm in a gesture of ultimate victory.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an explosive burst of male cheering and high-pitched shouting. Multiple voices overlap in a joyous, high-arousal cacophony. A rhythmic, upbeat electronic background track plays at a moderate tempo. (2) Mechanical clicking sounds of arcade buttons and joystick movements become prominent. A male voice speaks excitedly in Chinese, narrating the gameplay. Game SFX from Street Fighter II, including hitting sounds and character voices, are clearly audible in the mix. (3) A sharp 'Win' sound effect triggers. One male voice shouts with a proud tone, followed by group laughter. The sound of footsteps on a hard floor is heard as the primary player moves. (4) The sequence shifts to rapid button mashing and intense vocal reactions. 'Whoa!' and 'Oh!' exclamations from the onlookers punctuate the rhythmic clacking of the arcade controls. (5) After a moment of relative vocal quiet during intense play, a loud groan of defeat and a thudding sound (body hitting the floor) occur. This is immediately followed by mocking laughter and comedic commentary from the friends. (6) A final, sustained surge of cheering and screaming occurs as the group achieves their goal. The intensity is at its peak, with multiple men shouting 'Yes!' and celebrating with high vocal arousal. (7) The video ends with a single male voice shouting a humorous concluding statement with high confidence and volume, while the upbeat BGM continues until the cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Repeated Trial -> Failure/Frustration -> Final Success -> Celebration.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a group of adult men (referred to as 'uncles' in the text) obsessively trying to beat a classic arcade game from their childhood. It aims to capture the authentic joy, nostalgia, and camaraderie found in shared gaming experiences, using humor and high-energy reactions to engage the viewer.
